items.label: USAO-MA civil: CyTerra Corporation
items.detail: False Claims Act civil settlement over failure to give the Army accurate, complete and current cost or pricing data on labor hours when it negotiated three modifications of its AN/PSS-14 mine-detector contract (Truth in Negotiations Act); date is the announcement date. The release states 'CyTerra Corporation has agreed to pay the federal government $1.9 million' and 'CyTerra, headquartered in Waltham'. The two whistleblowers' $361,000 share comes out of the recovery and is not added. Civil action 06-CA-10550-NMG (D. Mass.); allegations only, no determination of liability.
